messages.subject: For Christian Klein | Enterprise AI, government relations and global stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear SAP Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Christian Klein, Chief Executive Officer.

SAP's growth in enterprise AI, cloud and digital transformation increasingly intersects with governments, public-sector modernization, regulation and responsible technology. That environment aligns closely with the work I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate cross-functional responses across complex regulated environments.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, stakeholder strategy and emerging-market institutional experience might support SAP's global priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to SAP.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
https://ragunauthramsaroop.com/
